title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.4 Partial Fractions: Integrate a rational function using the method of partial fractions.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.4 Partial Fractions: Integrate a rational function using the method of partial fractions.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, section "3.4 Partial Fractions", prints these objectives: "Integrate a rational function using the method of partial fractions." "Recognize simple linear factors in a rational function." "Recognize repeated linear factors in a rational function." "Recognize quadratic factors in a rational function.". The section text says: "We have seen some techniques that allow us to integrate specific rational functions. For example, we know that" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
